item.title: Re: Information on the IS and IS NOT entity from SCP-4840?
item.content:encoded:
They are not entities, IS is this universe and everything that exists in it, IS NOT are the impossible concepts that should not be, usually aren't but occasionally are even though they shouldn't, and some anomalies kind of fall in between.

Yeah, after rereading SCP-4840, I think your interpretation is pretty good. After looking over it now, its become clear to me that IS and IS NOT are at least related to the 'Question Entities' from SCP-5935, as they act almost identically - in the sense that they can act and seem alive (like the entity made of names does in 5935, and as both the serpent and his dark brother do) From that, I'd hazard a guess that IS and IS NOT were two questions: "What is?" and "What isn't?" respectively, and the asking of these questions created the universe. Then the books in the old library would be the answers to these questions, but that's just my headcanon.

On Eve, She could be out their somewhere, but that's for other writers to figure out. In terms of the locations for early humans:

  • Lilith - Foundation Containment as SCP-336
  • Adam El Asem - in Titania's Prison1
  • Cain - Foundation containment as SCP-073
  • Able - Foundation containment as SCP-076
  • Seth - On Audapopadopolis as SCP-4840-B

In terms of their descendants, I have no Idea.

Footnotes
1. BTW: It seems that Titania is a fae goddess, given the current draft for the demon hector.

item.title: Re: Information on the IS and IS NOT entity from SCP-4840?
item.content:encoded:
First of all, thank you for pointing out this SCP, I found it incredibly interesting as I love the lore of the origins of the SCP Universe, especaily somethign that integrates so many other important SCPs.

Now, as for these "entities" I read it differently. IS and IS NOT are not entitites, they are the truest philosophical dichotomy, more than good and evil, or natural vs artificial. The one true dicotomy is that which IS and that which IS NOT. IS is everything that exists. IS NOT is that which does not exist, which seems to be a smaller category with every entry on this site. They are not entities, IS is this universe and everything that exists in it, IS NOT are the impossible concepts that should not be, usually aren't but occassionaly are even though they shouldn't, and some anomalies kind of fall in between. One example of IS NOT is SCP-3001 Red Reality, the dimension between dimensions. There is nothing there, not even the reality to allow that which is to properly function should an instance of IS fall into the IS NOT. It's hard to comprehend this, but basically Seth is saying that at the beginning of the universe, Adam, Able, Cain, and Seth determined what IS. IS NOT was whatever did not fall under IS. IS is easy, IS NOT is not something any of us will properly understand by its very nature, and even Seth said as much since he was there when the books were written and tried to read them but even he doesn't really get it, or least not in any wya he can properly explain.

BTW: Lilith is also a part of this along with Adam and his sons since she is also Adam's first wife and she is either the mother of the three brothers or her powers produced Eve from Adam who is of the exceptional haplotype that produced a proper human, in which case where is Eve now? Was she mortal or is she still out there somewhere?
